findings.evidence: If you choose to access, visit and/or use any third party social networking service(s) that may be integrated with the Service, we may receive personally identifiable information and other information about you and your computer, mobile or other device that you have made available to those services, including information about your contacts on those services.
We may also provide your information to our advertisers, so that they can serve ads to you that meet your needs or match your interests.
